name: iam:PassRole + gamelift:CreateBuild + gamelift:CreateFleet
description: Upload a malicious game server build to GameLift, then create a fleet with an admin IAM instance role using SHARED_CREDENTIAL_FILE. The game server process reads the instance role credentials from /local/credentials/credentials and attaches AdministratorAccess to the starting user. Fleet provisioning typically takes 5-15 minutes.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass the target admin role to GameLift
Required to get temporary S3 upload credentials

admin: IAM role that trusts ec2.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
lateral: IAM role that trusts ec2.amazonaws.com with elevated permissions

references.title: Actions defined by Amazon GameLift - Service Authorization Reference
Set up an IAM service role for Amazon GameLift Servers

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass as the GameLift fleet instance role (must trust ec2.amazonaws.com)

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach AdministratorAccess to (auto-resolved from caller identity if not set)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for GameLift build and fleet

options.name: BUILD_NAME
options.description: Name tag for the GameLift build

options.name: FLEET_NAME
options.description: Name tag for the GameLift fleet

options.name: INSTANCE_TYPE
options.description: EC2 instance type for the fleet

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Delete build and fleet after execution. The starting user typically lacks gamelift:DeleteFleet and gamelift:DeleteBuild; use workspace cleanup with admin credentials instead.

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach an IAM policy to a user or role via a GameLift game server process that reads SHARED_CREDENTIAL_FILE instance role credentials
